# M3-E02: Qualify SQLite for the Local Store

## Status

Skipped by roadmap decision in version 1.3.5. This epic has no implementation
pull request and does not block M3-E06.

## Reason

The separate qualification gate found that the selected maintained adapter
does not expose the SQLite online backup C API. That API is not required to
create, commit, reopen, or read the live session store.

SQLite remains the selected engine. The frozen file, transaction, privacy,
capacity, and integrity rules remain in force.

## Handoff

- M3-E06 declares the direct adapter and proves its minimum package, pragma,
  commit, reopen, crash, path, and integrity behavior with the production
  store.
- M3-E17 creates a consistent snapshot with SQLite `VACUUM INTO`, under the
  writer barrier, and verifies the result before adoption.
- M3-E34 owns the complete production crash matrix.

## Completion Record

Beadwork closes `jido_console-m3e02` with reason `skipped`. M3-E02 does not
block M3-E06 or any later epic.

comments.text: Roadmap blocker found during adapter qualification. Exqlite 0.39.0 is current, maintained, MIT, native, and directly supports the required pragmas and cancellation, but it does not expose sqlite3_backup_init, sqlite3_backup_step, or sqlite3_backup_finish. The upstream Exqlite issue Expose online backup api (#144) remains open: https://github.com/elixir-sqlite/exqlite/issues/144. Its source contains only SQLite internal backup symbols; no public adapter function exists. Current esqlite, sqlite, and xqlite source searches also expose no online-backup function. The frozen M3 baseline and M3-E17 require the SQLite online backup API, and M3-E02 says not to change engines or weaken the rule inside this PR. No M3-E02 commit or PR was created.

Skipped by roadmap 1.3.5. No implementation PR. M3-E06 now owns the minimum direct Exqlite package, pragma, commit, reopen, crash, private-path, and integrity checks. M3-E17 uses SQLite VACUUM INTO under the writer barrier instead of requiring the unavailable adapter backup C API.
Ticket refinement: this closed record has delivery:none and no one-pr label. It is excluded from implementation, pull-request, readiness, and completion counts.
Skip audit complete: E02 is closed as skipped, has delivery:none, has no one-pr label, has no child tickets, and has zero dependency edges. All implementation and completion counts exclude it.
